humanEvidence: I think this is more about the final part of the actual porting, transitioning, and ingesting of the Mez design system into the actual repo. I think it's about having everything else ready first.
decision: Complete the Figma companion, channel systems and whole-system certification before integrating the design system into the real Mez Systems website repository.

frozenMilestone.treatment: Retain byte-for-byte as the approved first portable milestone. Later system work must produce a new candidate rather than mutating rc.1.

orderedWork.result: A code-backed Figma companion mirrors the canonical foundations, expressions and components without creating independent authority.
The remaining named channel systems are specified and proven from the same canonical engine.
The complete system passes cross-channel, multi-model, documentation and governance certification and a later immutable candidate is assembled.
The certified later candidate is finally ingested into one registered real website consumer and proves update and rollback.
